Stage 2 wall/floor-slab backgrounds, one 80x80 module (240x240 game px); tiles horizontally; slab top 4 rows and bottom 10 rows, walking line y=70. Names type_a / type_b per room type (studio -> living or bedroom, reception -> office); burned_a/b = soot-black full backgrounds; ransacked_a/b = transparent floor-clutter overlays (draw over any base). Mould and damp are baked in.

Stage 2 interior dividers between rooms, 8x80 (24x240 game px); doorway_open has a transparent opening (y 38-69) under a lintel so the rooms show through; front_door_frame has a taller opening (y 35-69) for door.png (16x32) sitting on the floor line; wall_segment = solid wall; doorway_burned = charred doorway. Slab rows match wall_modules.

Stage 2 central stairwell shaft, one module 80x80 (240x240 game px): landing platform in the middle at the walking line, stairs up on the left (open ceiling), stairs down on the right (open slab). light_unlit / light_lit are transparent overlays for the emergency fixture (top centre); swap them for the flicker, draw above shaft.

Stage 2 small props 16x16, anchored at the bottom: laundry_basket, toy_box (+_open), medicine_cabinet (+_open), charred_small (Burned furniture, small), debris_papers/debris_clothes (ransacked clutter)

Stage 2 medium/large props 32x32, anchored at the bottom: mattress, desk, filing_cabinet (+_open), washing_machine (+_open), storage_cage (+_open), utility_shelf, charred_debris (Burned furniture), debris_papers/debris_clothes (ransacked clutter). *_open = searched/ajar.

Stage 2 window 40x40 for an 80 px module; glass is exactly 32x32 at (4,4): place rain_window.png frames at +4,+4 (same x/y offset) to overlay. a = cross mullion, b = three panes with a transom, broken = burned rooms (no rain overlay needed, rain noise louder). Draw at the wall layer; centre it in the module, about y 14-54.

Iso floor tiles 32x16 art px (96x48 game px). ANCHOR: diamond centre = (16,8) (setOrigin 0.5); tiles tile seamlessly at 16 px / 8 px steps (centre of tile (x,y) = ((x-y)*16, (x+y+1)*8) art px, GDD 2). Frames <type>_<0|1> for types corridor (communal, concrete slabs), hallway (worn lino), living (wood boards), kitchen (lino checker), bedroom (carpet), bathroom (small tiles), office (carpet tiles), laundry (lino, variant 1 has a drain), storage (raw concrete), landing (stairwell landing, hazard dashes). ov_burned_* / ov_ransacked_* / ov_grime_* / ov_damp_* are transparent overlays clipped to the diamond (draw above the floor, below objects; grime and damp are for dirty/wet rooms and may be drawn at reduced alpha). Spare fx: iso_fx.

Iso FX, all 32x16 diamonds centred at (16,8). remembered_tile = flat #16191d diamond (tint/alpha in code to dim remembered tiles). spot_dashed = dashed spot-pick diamond outline (GDD 5.6). ripple_0..2 = broken ellipse arcs growing r 5/10/15 px (anim "ripple", 3 frames, once; draw on the source tile for the sound-off ripple, scale up for louder noise). mark_dismantled = faint floor mark left by a dismantled object. blood_floor_0..2 = dried blood stains on the floor (the old fx_blood sheets are still usable for hit splashes). Vignette is code-generated.

Iso walls, frames 16x48 art px. wall_<x|y>_<full|stub>_<finish>: x = edge runs toward the screen lower-right (ANCHOR: upper-left end of the base line at frame (0,40), the line ends at (16,48)); y = edge runs toward the lower-left (ANCHOR: upper-right end at (16,40), ends at (0,48)). Tile-corner vertex V(gx,gy) = ((gx-gy)*16, (gx+gy)*8) art px. Place x frames at (V.x, V.y-40) and y frames at (V.x-16, V.y-40) for the starting vertex V of the edge. Full = 40 px above the base line (120 game px), stub = 12 px (cutaway, 36 game px); all frames keep 16x48 and stubs use only the bottom 20 rows. Every wall has a 2 px cap (light top line). The y direction is drawn ~20% darker (shadow side). Finishes: concrete (corridor/landing/storage), plaster (hallway/laundry/office, also around windows and doors), wallp_a (living/bedroom, striped faded wallpaper with dado), wallp_b (kitchen, dotted grey-green), tile (bathroom, tiled to 28 px), burned (soot). corner_inner_* (flat post, concave corner) and corner_outer_* (split-shaded post, convex corner) are posts of width 4/6 with the corner vertex at frame (8,44). wall_*_window / window_broken: glass 8x18 px with skyline; stub window = low sill with a glass edge. door_<x|y>_<full|stub>_<closed|open|jammed|splintered|hanging|broken>: doorway frame + leaf in the wall segment (closed = leaf, open = leaf swung against the right jamb, jammed = warped leaf with boards, splintered/hanging = door damage stages 2/3, broken = permanently open with splinters; stub versions show the leaf as a low panel on the floor line). frontdoor_*_(closed|open|jammed): heavier metal door with a number plate (x 5-8, z 20-27 on the leaf). barricade_<x|y>_lv<1|2>_<0|1|2>: transparent overlay for the door gap, lv1 two planks, lv2 four planks plus steel brace; stage 0 intact, 1 damaged, 2 nearly broken (reused for the 5 damage steps: 0,0,1,2,2). Draw barricade above the door frame. Wall opening is at x 3..12, z 0..31 in every door frame.

Iso stairwell pieces, frames 64x64 art px. stairs_*: 2x2-tile footprint (28x28 units), ANCHOR = footprint centre at (32,44). stairs_up_ne rises toward the upper-right (-y), stairs_up_nw toward the upper-left (-x); 8 steps, 24 px of rise, near-side handrail. stairs_down_*: the matching stair going down into a dark opening (treads descend away from the near rim). The four are used for the central shaft: draw up flight on the landing side, down flight opposite; the code mirrors for the other orientations. light_unlit / light_lit: the landing emergency fixture, transparent frames, fixture centre at (32,20); lit has a dithered amber glow (swap for the flicker, draw above walls; the soft light pool is code-made).

Iso props, frames 32x56 art px (1x1 footprint). ANCHOR: tile centre at (16,48) (floor diamond spans y 40-56, so setOrigin(0.5, 48/56)); props stand within +-7 units of it, tall ones up to 40 px high. Frames <id>_<a|b> and <id>_open_<a|b> (searched/ajar). Facing a: front toward the lower-left, backed to the upper-right wall; b: front toward the lower-right, backed to the upper-left wall; mirror (flipX) for the other two facings. Mounted objects (bathroom_cabinet, medicine_cabinet) and curtains are drawn at wall height at the back of the tile (draw at the wall edge). ids: fridge, fridge_open, kitchen_cupboard, kitchen_cupboard_open, kitchen_drawer, kitchen_drawer_open, chair, wardrobe, wardrobe_open, bathroom_cabinet, bathroom_cabinet_open, medicine_cabinet, medicine_cabinet_open, toilet_tank, sink_pipes, water_heater, tv, microwave, rain_collector, water_filter, planter, curtains, potted_plant, toolbox, toolbox_open, oil_lamp, filing_cabinet, filing_cabinet_open, washing_machine, washing_machine_open, laundry_basket, toy_box, toy_box_open, utility_shelf, charred_debris; debris_papers / debris_clothes = flat ransacked clutter (one facing). Lamp: oil_lamp; light pool is code-made. Mirroring note: lighting is baked (left face lighter), so mirrored copies swap light direction, which is acceptable.

Iso large props, frames 64x72 art px: table, sofa, mattress, desk, storage_cage (+_open), workbench, survivor_bed, charred_big (1x2 footprint, 14x14... 28x12 units) and bed_frame, hero_bed (2x2 footprint). ANCHOR: centre of the footprint rectangle at (32,52) (setOrigin(0.5, 52/72)). Long axis runs along the front face: for facing a the footprint is 2 tiles along x (front toward the lower-left), for b it is 2 tiles along y (front toward the lower-right); mirror for the other two facings. Frames <id>_<a|b>. The bed_frame is the stripped salvage frame with a stained mattress, hero_bed is the made-up bed (teal blanket), survivor_bed a cot.

Frames 16x32 art px, ANCHOR: feet / tile centre at (16/2, 30) = (8,30) (setOrigin(0.5, 30/32)). 8 facings in the order S, SW, W, NW, N, NE, E, SE (S = toward the camera, E = screen right, N = away). Frame names <anim>_<DIR>_<i>, animation keys <anim>_<DIR> (e.g. walk_SE). SW, W, NW are baked mirrors of SE, E, NE (no flipX needed). 1 px near-black outline. Hero: faded teal jacket, dark hair, rust backpack visible from behind and the side, pale face on the front. idle 2 (2 fps), walk 4 (8 fps; use a higher fps for running), attack 3 (windup, swing, recover; swings a pipe on the right hand), death 3 (stagger, kneel, isoLying).

Walker zombie, office worker: dirty grey shirt, loosened dark tie, charcoal trousers, short dark hair, dried blood on the collar and chest.
